item.body:
### Summary
As a member reading the Messages list, I want each conversation on two lines under its title at most, laid out like the topic lists (flag or interlocutor on the left, « last poster - time » on the right), so that the rows stay compact and every list reads the same way.

Milestone: **M4**. Source: operator UI comparison of 2026-11-14, capture 04 (Messages, logged in; pseudos and titles redacted).

### Observed (legacy @ `87fe0d1c`, SwiftHFR @ `37c099b5`)
| | Legacy | SwiftHFR |
|---|---|---|
| Under the title | **one line**: interlocutor on the left (« Interlocuteurs multiples » for a group MP, `Classes/HFRMPViewController.m:135`, `HFRswift/Swift/MPListView.swift:784`), « last poster - time » on the right | up to **three lines**: interlocutor, then « ⚑ cur / max » alone on its line, then « last poster · relative time », all on the left |
| Row height | compact | taller (three lines, larger avatar) |

### Requested (operator, 2026-11-14)
- **One-to-one MP**: the interlocutor on the second line, left-aligned, as legacy; « last poster - time » on the right of the same line.
- **Group MP**: in place of the interlocutor, **« ⚑ current page / last page »** as in Favoris, because a group MP is meant to read like a multi-member topic (#858). **No « Interlocuteurs multiples »**: the group icon already says it.
- **No extra line** in these rows: find the layout optimisations that keep one info line.
- The flag is a SwiftHFR addition (legacy shows none in the MP list): kept, on the left like in the topic lists.

### Scope
- The MP row (`App/SwiftHFR/Messages/MessageRowView.swift`) on the shared row component of group L / #572, with the same info-line layout as the topic row of #817 / #857.
- VoiceOver label follows the visible order.
- Ledger: `gap-edit` of the MP list row (GAP-110 or the row's own GAP line).

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A one-to-one row: title, then « interlocutor ……… last poster - time » on one line.
- [ ] A group row: title, then « ⚑ cur / max ……… last poster - time » on one line; no « Interlocuteurs multiples ».
- [ ] Row height back to legacy's at default Dynamic Type; screenshots side by side on the PR (redacted).

Related: #572, #817, #857, #858, #648, #651.

### Operator precision (2026-11-14)

The info line under a **group MP**'s title shows, like a public topic but without more:
- **« ⚑ page read / page count »** (the flag position, as in Favoris);
- **the last poster's name**;
- **the date, relative**: « x min » under 2 h, « x h » under 24 h, the date beyond.

No interlocutor list, no « Interlocuteurs multiples », no extra line. One-to-one MPs: interlocutor on the left, « last poster – time » on the right, same time format. This matches the request above; it fixes the time format.
